description: Build actions inherit the dev-shell env (NIX_CFLAGS_COMPILE, NIX_LDFLAGS, SDKROOT, MACOSX_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET) outside the key, and buck2 has no setting to clear it. Needed variables must become declared action env via the toolchain. Invasive: tk is also the interactive wrapper. See docs/research/remote-execution-and-caching.md (commit adc3619d) §5.
title: tk starts the buck2 daemon with a minimal pinned environment (G4)
